justification.statement: v2 is the 2-adic valuation on Q(sqrt 5): v2(2) = 1 and v2 of a unit of Z[phi] is 0
justification.text: For x = (a + b√5)/d, v2 reads the 2-adic valuations of a - b, 2b and d: 2 = 2·1 has valuation 1, and φ = (1 + √5)/2 is a unit of Z[φ] (φ·(φ - 1) = 1), so its valuation is 0.

justification.statement: the identity pose factors as 1 x 1 and sits at the tree's root vertex
justification.text: The identity matrix is x ↦ 1·x·1, so both factors are the unit quaternion 1, which lies at the root vertex: distance 0 and no branch, written -1.
